item.title: Deploy Hugo to GitHub Pages from a Private Repository
item.description: Want to publish your site on GitHub Pages from a private repository, but don’t want to pay for a GitHub Pro subscription? You can set it up so the site lives in a public repository and deploys automatically on every push, while the source code stays private. Here’s how I did it — a handy cheat sheet, essentially.
